# Vanatvam

> Vanatvam Private Limited is a Bangalore-based company developing natural, sustainable managed farm communities in Karnataka: restored native forest ecosystems and farmland plots for families who want a real connection with nature. Communities are located along the Bangalore–Mysore corridor, with one project at Pavagada.

Vanatvam (also written VanaTvam) develops and stewards managed farmland communities. Each project is planned around ecological restoration, native biodiversity and long-term land stewardship, and every parcel undergoes legal title verification before procurement.

## Company

- Name: Vanatvam Private Limited

## Projects

- [Madhuvana](https://www.vanatvam.com/madhuvana): 17 acres of quarter-acre farm plots off the Bangalore–Mysore highway, near Maddur and Mandya, surrounded by the River Kaveri and its canals. Developed with Indus Herbs.
- [Anantavana](https://www.vanatvam.com/anantavana): a sustainable reforestation community on the River Kabini for nature lovers. Developed with Indus Herbs.
- [Ishavana](https://www.vanatvam.com/ishavana) (also spelled Eeshavana): a nature-first Kaveri riverfront community near Shivanasamudra Falls.
- [Brindavana](https://www.vanatvam.com/brindavana): a reforestation community at Krishnapura, Pavagada, turning dry, thorny land into green shade.
- [All projects](https://www.vanatvam.com/projects): overview of every Vanatvam community.
